subject.name: Photonics Engineers
subject.summary: Photonics engineers (O*NET 17-2199.07) design, analyze, integrate, and test light-based systems or devices, including laser, fiber-optic, and imaging technologies. Working with system requirements, optical models, device specifications, test records, and safety requirements, they produce traceable designs, prototype test conclusions, and production transfer handovers. Laser, electrical, and laboratory safety must follow institutional procedures; design validation and release require corresponding authorization. Work settings, qualifications, and final responsibility must be checked against local and institutional rules.
